grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, oil, vinegar, tinned sweetcorn, fresh vegetables and seeds are all ordinary home staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: A muffin tin, bowl, jug and grater are ordinary kit, and a one-bowl muffin mix suits a beginner.

works.reason: 250g flour to about 330ml liquid plus wet vegetables makes a workable eggless batter that will rise at 200°C in 20 to 22 minutes and fill 12 muffins.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers grating two carrots, chopping rocket and spring onions and mixing, and 30 minutes of cooking roughly covers the bake plus cooling.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used in the steps and nothing unlisted appears beyond water; the step's 'paprika' clearly means the listed smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: A full 60g bag of rocket heads the title and the mix, which makes sense for a late-May afternoon snack.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Part wholemeal muffins packed with carrot, sweetcorn, greens and seeds make a filling, real-food snack a family would bake again.
